technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (RSI-9 overbought, StochRSI cross-up, CMF cross-up) show bullish confluence, but price remains below key moving averages (50/200) and Ichimoku cloud with weak trend strength (ADX 24.8), limiting swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: F shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 50 days—insufficient smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (11/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 purchase, 1 full sale) and absent news sentiment provide insufficient conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (346.7) with flat yield curve and negative macro score (-3) creates severely unfavourable conditions; earnings in 50 days adds moderate event risk but is secondary to acute volatility crisis.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum confluence (RSI-9 overbought, StochRSI cross-up, CMF cross-up) with extreme fear sentiment (11/100) and price near support (10.1624) creates contrarian entry opportunity for swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro crisis regime (VIX 346.7), price below all key moving averages (EMA-50, SMA-50/200, Ichimoku cloud), weak trend strength (ADX 24.8), zero fundamental conviction, and earnings event risk in 50 days make this a high-risk, low-conviction setup in unfavourable conditions.
